description:
Generate a realistic MAX webhook Update for tests, shaped like the official schema, plus a curl command to
    send it to your local webhook. Lets you test a bot before it passes moderation or without a token.

lang.description: Answer language: 'en' English, 'ru' Russian. Pick the user's language; default ru (or XONTA_MAX_LANG)
lang.title: Lang

payload.description: Callback payload or bot_started deep link payload
payload.title: Payload

secret.description: Webhook secret to put into X-Max-Bot-Api-Secret
secret.title: Secret

text.description: Message text (message_created/edited, comments) or new title
text.title: Text

update_type.description: message_created, message_callback, bot_started, bot_added, bot_removed, message_edited, message_removed, user_added, user_removed, comment_created, chat_title_changed, dialog_muted, bot_admin_permissions_changed, …
update_type.title: Update Type

webhook_url.description: If set, also returns a curl command that POSTs the update there
webhook_url.title: Webhook Url

name: max_mock_update
